BL-1703 — A launch of any pack whose seats use the local model endpoint probes ollama first - an answering endpoint is used and recorded as external, a silent one is started by the swarm, waited for and recorded as swarm-owned, and one that never answers refuses the launch before any seat starts, naming the endpoint; packs with no local endpoint launch exactly as before
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Operator grounding, checked live 2026-09-23 (intake below):
- `ollama serve` is hand-started (`OLLAMA_MODELS=/mnt/d/dev/ollama/models
  /mnt/d/dev/ollama/bin/ollama serve`, parented by WSL `/init`); this
  host has no systemd, so nothing restarts or supervises it.
- No launch gate …
Approval context: Your 2026-09-23 LOCAL_AGENT ask to make ollama a swarm-managed ancillary is split into three tickets - this one (start and probe at launch), BL-1704 (the stop paths stop what the swarm started) and BL-1705 (the janitor reaps ghost runners and detached run clients). Please review this featur…
BL-1703 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1703" (or "reject BL-1703 <reason>") to act.
